research_question: Can a bounded allocation-free C11 reference fast path parse and classify representative Ethernet, VLAN, IPv4, TCP, and UDP frames while failing closed on malformed or truncated input?

included: Ethernet II and single 802.1Q VLAN parsing
fixed rule-table pass, drop, and queue decisions
excluded: DPDK, XDP, eBPF, RDMA, RoCE, or GPUDirect
NIC firmware, FPGA, ASIC, or NVIDIA BlueField offload
line-rate, latency-SLA, production, security-certification, or hardware claims

required_cases: fragment does not expose unverified ports

prohibited_interpretations: cross-machine comparison without a separately frozen protocol

claim_gates.bounded_c11_packet_pipeline: eligible only after compiler and test receipt
